_readme: Registry of paid 3rd-party placements and partner accounts. Hand-maintained.
export_dash_json.py reads this, pulls whatever it can live, and writes
~/marketing-dash/data/social.json for the dashboard's Social & Sponsorships tab.
tweet_ids  - X post IDs for the placement. Impressions/engagements pulled live.
youtube    - no API key on file, so `views` is manual. Add YOUTUBE_API_KEY to
spotify    - podcast platforms publish no play counts; manual or leave null.
cost       - what we paid, if known. Drives cost-per-1k-impressions.
